SELECT RESULT_DATE, SUM(RESULT_COUNT) AS RESULT_COUNT FROM (
SELECT TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{start_date},'yyyy-mm-dd') + ((LEVEL-1)),'yyyy-mm-dd') AS result_date, 0 AS result_count
SELECT TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#{start_year}||'-01', 'yyyy-mm'), LEVEL - 1),'yyyy-mm') AS result_date, 0 AS result_count
SELECT TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#{start_year}, 'yyyy'), (LEVEL - 1)*12),'yyyy') AS result_date, 0 AS result_count
FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= (TO_DATE(#{end_date}) - TO_DATE(#{start_date}) + 1) 12 (TO_NUMBER(#{end_year}) - TO_NUMBER(#{start_year}) + 1)
UNION ALL SELECT
, access_cnt AS result_count FROM STATISTICS_COUNT
UNION ALL SELECT
, access_cnt AS result_count FROM STATISTICS_COUNT_MOBILE
) GROUP BY result_date ORDER BY result_date ASC

mapper.insert: MERGE INTO STATISTICS_COUNT a USING dual ON ( homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND access_date = #{start_date} ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET access_cnt = access_cnt + 1 WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( access_idx, homepage_id, access_date, access_cnt ) VALUES ( STATISTICS_COUNT_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{homepage_id}, #{start_date}, 1 )

MERGE INTO STATISTICS_COUNT_MOBILE a USING dual ON ( homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND access_date = #{start_date} ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET access_cnt = access_cnt + 1 WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( access_idx, homepage_id, access_date, access_cnt ) VALUES ( STATISTICS_COUNT_MOBILE_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{homepage_id}, #{start_date}, 1 )
